params.message:
Update laravel/framework to v13.42.0 for CVE-2026-128083

composer audit --locked failed on main: GHSA-63hm-g96r-2m2q affects laravel/framework below 13.40.0. The lock moves the framework and the packages below it; composer.json is unchanged.

The new framework encodes a bare string passed to route() as a query, so the address window of the transport tab passes its redirect as an array.
